label: Sensor traits
description: Always-on ways a unit finds enemies or hides from them, on top of its sight band. They need no key; the same effects on a key are patterns (cloak, reveal an area, mark a target, jam sensors).

terms.label: Radar
terms.description: Shows enemies in a wide circle beyond its sight as blips on the team's minimap: where they are, not what they are. A blip can't be aimed at until someone sees it, and stealthy enemies don't show.

terms.label: Detector
terms.description: Reveals stealthy, cloaked, burrowed and disguised enemies close to it, for the whole team.

terms.label: Stealth
terms.description: Hard to spot: enemies see it only at close range, and radar never shows it. Firing gives it away for a moment, and a detector nearby reveals it.
terms.notes: Always on. Turning fully invisible, on a key or not, is the cloak pattern.

terms.label: Spotter
terms.description: Enemies it sees stay marked for the whole team for a few seconds after they leave its sight, visible through walls and fog while the mark lasts.
terms.notes: Unlike the mark weapon trait, it marks everything it sees, not only what it hits, and adds no extra damage.
